# DataTable

## Purpose and role

Rows of columns with a row cursor, sorting and optional inline edit.

Role: `grid (read-mostly table)`.

## Keyboard

| Key (Desktop) | Key (Vim) | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `↑↓` | `↑↓` | Move |
| `PgUp PgDn` | `PgUp PgDn` | Page |
| `Home End` | `g G` | First / last |
| `Enter` | `Enter` | Activate |
| `s` | `s` | Sort |
| `Ctrl+A` | `Ctrl+A` | Select all |

## Mouse

| Target | Click | Double click | Secondary click | Drag | Wheel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| row | moves the cursor (selects) | activates the row | selects the row, opens its context menu | — | scrolls the rows |
| header | sorts by the column | — | — | — | — |
| scrollbar | pages toward the click (`TrackClick::Page`) | — | — | the thumb scrolls | scrolls |

## Hints by state

| State | Desktop | Vim |
|---|---|---|
| focused | `↑↓` Move · `s` Sort | `↑↓` Move · `s` Sort |

## Knobs

| Knob | Default | Layer | Standard |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nav` | the NavProfile's keys (Desktop: arrows, PgUp/PgDn, Home/End) | profile | APG keyboard interaction |
| `type_ahead` | on under Desktop, off under Vim | profile | APG type-ahead; WCAG 2.1.4 |
| `keymap` | the command enum's `default_keymap()` | key map | WCAG 2.1.4 (remappable) |
| `click` | `ClickPolicy::DATA`: one click selects, a double click activates | widget | macOS lists (SI14) |

## Keyboard-only path

- Move: `↑↓`
- Page: `PgUp PgDn`
- First / last: `Home End`
- Activate: `Enter`
- Sort: `s`
- Select all: `Ctrl+A`

## Mouse-first path

- row: click moves the cursor (selects); double click activates the row; wheel scrolls the rows.
- header: click sorts by the column; double click —; wheel —.
- scrollbar: click pages toward the click (`TrackClick::Page`); double click —; wheel scrolls.
